mapper.select: select (doc->'org'->'room')::text room from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
insert into ai_usage (tenant_id, day, calls) values (#{tid}, cast(#{day} as date), 1) on conflict (tenant_id, day) do update set calls = ai_usage.calls + 1 returning calls
insert into ai_usage_f (tenant_id, day, feature, calls) values (#{tid}, cast(#{day} as date), #{f}, 1) on conflict (tenant_id, day, feature) do update set calls = ai_usage_f.calls + 1 returning calls
mapper.update: update ai_usage_f set tin = tin + #{tin}, tout = tout + #{tout} where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = cast(#{day} as date) and feature = #{f}
mapper.select: select feature, sum(calls)::int calls, sum(tin)::bigint tin, sum(tout)::bigint tout from ai_usage_f where day > current_date - 31 group by feature order by feature
mapper.update: update ai_usage set tin = tin + #{tin}, tout = tout + #{tout} where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = cast(#{day} as date)
mapper.select: select day::text, calls, tin::int, tout::int from ai_usage where tenant_id = #{tid} and day > current_date - 31 order by day desc
select coalesce(sum(tin + tout), 0)::bigint n from ai_usage where tenant_id = #{tid} and day >= cast(#{from} as date)
select coalesce(sum(tokens), 0)::bigint n from ai_credit where tenant_id = #{tid} and month = #{month} and status = 'paid'
select feature, sum(calls)::int calls, sum(tin)::bigint tin, sum(tout)::bigint tout from ai_usage_f where day >= cast(#{from} as date) group by feature order by feature

select pack, tokens::bigint tokens, amount, to_char(paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') at from ai_credit where tenant_id = #{tid} and month = #{month} and status = 'paid' order by paid_at
mapper.insert: insert into ai_credit (id, tenant_id, month, pack, tokens, amount, order_id, by_email) values (#{id}, #{tid}, #{month}, #{pack}, #{tokens}, #{amount}, #{orderId}, #{by})
mapper.select: select id, month, pack, tokens::bigint tokens, amount, status from ai_credit where tenant_id = #{tid} and order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: update ai_credit set status = 'failed' where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id} and status = 'ready'
update ai_credit set status = 'paid', payment_key = #{pk}, paid_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id} and status <> 'paid'
